description: Header file defining the QuicIntervalSet<T> class, a data structure for managing sorted, disjoint intervals with operations like union, intersection, difference, and containment checks.

classes.name: quic::QuicIntervalSet
classes.description: A template class representing a sorted set of non-empty, disjoint intervals with efficient set operations.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an interval or point to the set, merging overlapping or adjacent intervals.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a value or interval is contained within the set.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Merges another QuicIntervalSet into this set.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Removes specified intervals or points from the set.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Checks if the set intersects with another set.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds the interval containing a value or wholly containing a given interval.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the set.
